Description
Discover the pinnacle of silver craftsmanship with these American Eagle One Ounce Silver Coin, available in exclusive tubes of 20 pieces. Minted with precision at the United States Mint at West Point, this collector’s edition marks a continued legacy since 1986, offering an unparalleled addition to your collection.
The obverse showcases Adolph A. Weinman’s iconic Liberty in full stride, enveloped in the flag’s folds, capturing the essence of freedom and courage. Enhanced details and Weinman’s artist mark pay homage to the original vision, surrounded by the inscriptions “LIBERTY,” “YYYY” and “IN GOD WE TRUST.” The reverse features a majestic eagle, crafted by Emily Damstra and sculpted by Michael Gaudioso, descending with an oak branch in its talons, symbolizing strength and continuity. The inscriptions “UNITED STATES OF AMERICA,” “E PLURIBUS UNUM,” “1 OZ. FINE SILVER,” and “ONE DOLLAR” frame this emblematic scene.
With no mintage limit and a reed pattern variation that sets a new standard in anti-counterfeiting measures, these coins are a testament to the United States Mint’s commitment to excellence and security. Secure your tube of 20 today from Bullion Trading LLC and be part of the enduring legacy of the American Eagle Silver Coins.
